STRAIT OF HORMUZ · SHIPPING INTELLIGENCE

Maritime intelligence for the world's most watched waterway

Hormuz Watch tracks vessel movements, shipping routes, oil benchmarks and market signals around the Strait of Hormuz — the chokepoint through which roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes.

Risk summary

elevated

Simulated conditions show elevated disruption risk in the Strait. Insurance surcharges and rerouting pressure on tanker lanes are the primary drivers in this illustrative scenario — none of this reflects live conditions.
